step1.title: Create Your Profile

step2.title: Talk to CuraAI

testimonials.title: Trusted by Thousands
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from patients, doctors, and healthcare professionals.

items.name: Priya Rajan
items.text: CuraAI explained my lab report in Tamil clearly. I finally understood my test results without needing a translator.

items.name: Dr. Karthik Sundaram
items.text: The AI risk prediction tool helps me flag high-risk patients early. It's like having an intelligent assistant.

items.text: The medicine reminder saved me from missing my BP medication for weeks. My health has improved significantly.

items.name: Dr. Arjun Patel
items.text: HealixAI's symptom checker is impressive. Patients come in better prepared, making consultations more efficient.
